facts.fact: Ila and Rohan's grandfather is named Warden Harish of the Shilak post (as in the outline beat).
facts.why: needed because the queen's letter names him.

facts.fact: Prince Udai of Neshar is Kunal's grandfather.
facts.why: needed because the outline says Kunal's grandfather walked hers to his death.

facts.fact: Ila swore an archive oath, when taking her commission, binding her silence about what the crown's papers hold; the queen's letter adds 'Tell no one Neshar's part'.
facts.why: needed because the beat makes her silence rest on the commission's archive oath.

facts.fact: Ila reads the grandfather's gloves, left palms together and square on the stone, as a deliberate payment-sign, not an accident.
facts.why: needed for the midpoint mirror; builds on F490.
